## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Florence, Italy. It starts at Via Ricasoli 39.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Florence attracts visitors from around the globe to witness the masterpiece of Michelangelo, the David statue. This renowned sculpture is widely known as one of the most famous worldwide, representing the strength and beauty of youth in the Renaissance era.
>
> Visitors can obtain their tickets from the company representative before experiencing the Michelangelo Buonarotti museum.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €41.62. It was rated 3.8 out of 5 from 467 ratings and 224 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
